items.title: Pump Station SCADA Upgrade
items.challenge: Legacy RTUs with no remote visibility across 14 pump stations.
items.solution: Replaced RTUs with modern PLCs, added 4G telemetry and a central SCADA with alarm management.

items.title: Turbine Hall Drives Retrofit
items.challenge: Obsolete drives on cooling-water pumps causing unplanned trips.
items.solution: Staged VFD retrofit during planned outages with new motor protection.

items.title: Port Crane Condition Monitoring
items.challenge: Crane gearbox failures discovered only after breakdown.
items.solution: Vibration and temperature sensing with IIoT dashboards and predictive alerts.

items.title: Bottling Line Vision Inspection
items.challenge: Manual cap and label inspection at 30,000 bottles per hour.
items.solution: Inline smart cameras with automatic rejection and MES reporting.

note: All projects are demo placeholders. Results figures are illustrative only.
